name: Ra
title: Divine Eclipse
summary: Bring the power of the sun to burn your foes increasing your own power in battle.
lore: He is the sun, master of the heavens. For all his might, however, Ra’s immense age and responsibilities have begun to catch up with him. Although one would never guess it, witnessing his efforts on Aaru’s behalf in the War of Pyramids, Ra grows tired—and that exhaustion has rendered him angry, even tyrannical in his need to assert his role and solve the realm’s problems now.
archetype_description: Increase on hit damage by 1% for each piece of leather armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: Then increase CDMG by 3% for each Blaze placed (stacking up to 15 times).
Also increase this hero's Crushing Hit Chance by 2%. Stacks do not reset betweenwaves.
Each hit increases the DEF this attack ignores by 20%, up to a maximum of 60%, and activates Blaze on each target.
